title: He Had Two Gardens, and It Went to His Head

meta.name: v5_k18_04_two-gardens
meta.title: He Had Two Gardens, and It Went to His Head

lines.text: He had two gardens, and it went to his head.
And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.

quran.ar: ۞ وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلࣰا رَّجُلَیۡنِ جَعَلۡنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَیۡنِ مِنۡ أَعۡنَـٰبࣲ وَحَفَفۡنَـٰهُمَا بِنَخۡلࣲ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَیۡنَهُمَا زَرۡعࣰا

lines.text: I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men.

quran.ar: أَنَا۠ أَكۡثَرُ مِنكَ مَالࣰا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرࣰا

lines.text: He still said: I am greater.
Wealth can make a person look down.
A gift is not a rank.
